links.comparator_used: Human review alone (HR, single-physician) and human review with blinded expert over-reading (HR-ex), without LLM prescreening
links.outcome: Error-detection accuracy, false-negative and false-positive rates, and review time in ultrasound report quality control
links.effect: Accuracy: 4o-HYB 80.2%, v3-HYB 82.5%, HR 82.3%, HR-ex 87.3%. FN rate: 4o-HYB 34.2% and v3-HYB 27.3% vs HR-ex 16.9% (both p < 0.001). Median review time fell from 51.0 s (HR-ex) to 11.0 s (4o-HYB) and 12.0 s (v3-HYB). In supplementary validation, v3.2-HYB vs HR had FN rates of 22.6% vs 24.3%, FP rates of 7.7% vs 10.0%, and median review times of 15.4 vs 24.3 s.
links.tradeoff: Hybrid workflows missed more errors than expert over-read review (higher FN rates). Accuracy was lower than HR-ex. Severity assessment did not show preferential omission of clinically significant errors.
links.quote: The LLM-assisted HYB achieved accuracy comparable to single-physician review while substantially reducing audit time.
